g.text: Attachment streaming upload and asynchronous scan
as the exact OBS Object Key
verify file part EOF after N bytes
[Prefer wait=N and scan reaches a terminal state within min(N,10)]
No Pod-local file and no complete byte array.
At most 1 MiB of application in-flight buffers
per upload. OBS slowdown propagates backpressure.
Create-only conflict marks the ID FAILED and does not
overwrite or delete an object of unproven ownership.
OBS I/O and scanning never hold a DB transaction.
An expired lease can be recovered by another Pod.
Only READY can be resolved for chat.send.
